{
  "question_intent": "Clarification on NII, USCB, and BUK profitability and investment strategies",
  "main_topics": [
    "NII growth and consensus",
    "USCB business mix and growth",
    "BUK profitability and investment"
  ],
  "answer_completeness": "Complete",
  "response_stance": "Direct",
  "evidence_level": "High",
  "contains_numeric_evidence": true,
  "contains_forward_guidance": false,
  "narrative_alignment": "Aligned",
  "question_quote": "So I just wanted to actually follow up. I know you did comment a bit on the [Q126 Analyst] call on it, but the commentary on NII and consensus being light in 2027, I'm just kind of curious because, obviously, I think in terms of structural hedge modelling and rate assumptions, I think most analysts probably have the same, if not higher rate assumption and they've been modelling this now for a long time. And then, say, on USCB, you're saying it's a bit more of a shift to non-NII. So really just trying to understand a bit better where you think the disconnects are? And then secondly, when I think about BUK in terms of profitability, if I just run with rate expectations, I get much higher profitability than the greater than 20% [RoTE]. I appreciate there's a greater than. So just trying to think how you think about that? Why then with the target you say greater than 20% [RoTE] and/or are you looking to redeploy more of the revenue into investment, et cetera, but just how you're thinking about that as well?",
  "answer_quote": "Okay. So let me start with the first one. I'll just go back to what I said on the call. I think as we talk about NII, we tend to talk more heavily about the BUK and I think that's well understood, well modelled. And we've been disclosing it for a very long time, so it's something that's clearly understood by the market. I think for the other businesses because they are newer, perhaps with less of a track record, and it's taking us a while perhaps to sort of really get a clear idea out there about what we think the possibilities of those businesses are. Really outside of BUK, I would say all of the areas show some upside to consensus, but I would say notably the two that I called out, and actually, if you look at the sort of Q1 NII growth year-on-year, [UKCB] and USCB both showed quite substantial growth. That's coming not only from our lending, but it's also coming from deposits because as we bring on new clients, we're also bringing their deposits with them. So you've got quite a holistic rounded growth there and obviously, the opportunities that we've got going forward as we land iPortal. On USCB, you're right about the change in mix. But we've seen very good organic growth in this business over time, I think 10% growth to the first quarter. And then you have to think about what we're layering on top of that, there will be new partners in time. As we bring those partners into play, we would expect to bring all of the products that we have across USCB to those partners, not only Best Egg, but the considerable growth that we've got in our deposit franchise. We feel that that's going really well in the US. So it's more of a holistic point also in USCB. So there's nothing I would call out in terms of a single factor. Just I think we probably have more confidence in those businesses than is yet reflected in consensus. For BUK, look, the target is greater than [20% RoTE], we do expect to invest more in the business, but all of that is contained within the cost: income ratio guidance that we've already given you. If anything, what we are telling you is that we see opportunities to invest in that faster, which is why we're skewing the investment this quarter as we are, to try and bring things forward because we see really clear opportunities to take cost out of that business. We do expect to see lending continue to grow. Obviously, we expect to see a normalisation of the loan loss rate, but we now think that, that will be around 30 basis points. So we've given you all the factors, and we're saying greater than 20% [RoTE], but it is a competitive market. We see that now. We see that at points through the cycle. So we're just mindful of that.",
  "reason": "The response directly addresses the question's intent, providing a clear and complete answer with high evidence level, including numeric evidence and aligned narrative. The question and answer quotes are continuous excerpts from the original text.",
  "contains_numeric_evidence": true,
  "contains_forward_guidance": false
}
